evidence: Independent implementation of the documented power-model CRM and Bayesian model averaging. Current skeleton inputs are prior medians. Source formulas and policy descriptions were read from official pages and manuals; no native executable was run and no original program is redistributed.

sources.role: Current version, prior-median convention, and 2.2.2 escalation and final MTD changes.
Power model, normal prior variance two, evidence-weighted posterior means, and mixture safety probability. Its prior-mean elicitation predates the current input convention.
Prior medians, three-skeleton example, model limits, and distinction between BMA and DA workflows.
CRM Suite identity and confirmation that it succeeds BMA-CRM Simulator.
Nondecreasing skeletons and Appendix II trial-conduct rules, including first-untried restriction and raw toxicity at intervening doses.

validation_reference: tools/reference_bmacrm.R uses base-R binomial densities and scalar alpha-space quadrature for ten independent audit scenarios. Counts are synthetic; no native output parity is claimed.
limitations: DA-CRM, pending-outcome and look-ahead workflows, timing and operating-characteristic simulation, and native files/reports remain pending. Online catalog entry 133 was not accessible and is not assumed equivalent.
